title_cyr: А јас останав тебе да те чекам
title_latin: A jas ostanav tebe da te čekam
title_en: And I Stayed to Wait for You
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; the modern wording suggests a recent pop song but I cannot name an author. Standard Macedonian, no dialect forms.

lines.en: The nights are long and heavy,
You left alone without a goodbye,
but you took a part of me with you.

lines.cyr: А јас останав тебе да те чекам,
lines.lat: A jas ostanav tebe da te čekam,
lines.en: And I stayed to wait for you,

lines.cyr: да се надевам и за тебе страдам.
lines.lat: da se nadevam i za tebe stradam.
lines.en: to hope and to suffer for you.

lines.cyr: само слика и споменот што боли.
lines.lat: samo slika i spomenot što boli.
lines.en: is only a photo and a memory that hurts.

lines.cyr: Каде си пак да те видам,
lines.lat: Kade si pak da te vidam,
lines.en: Where are you, so that I may see you,
maybe I will stop the pain.
But you are so far away, my dear,
too far for me to touch you.
